note: The template every other topic config is copied from. Three things change per topic: the award bodies and editorial lists that actually exist for this food, the facet axis, and the title strings. The method in .claude/skills/consensus-guide/SKILL.md does not change.

awardBodies.name: 50 Top Pizza Europa
awardBodies.note: Italian panel judging Neapolitan technique. Publishes a ranked European top 50 with a year on it.

awardBodies.name: National Pizza Awards
awardBodies.note: READ THIS BEFORE COLLECTING. The site rebuilds each cycle and retires the old results page: /the-uks-best-pizza, which carried the 2025 placings, special awards and finalists, now 404s. The live pages are /finalists (current year's shortlist, venue in the h4 and its pizza in the p beneath) and /previous-winners (champions by year, winner only). The final is in November, so from about September there are finalists but no winner. Neither page prints towns - the awards' host, Dine Out magazine, publishes them in its finalists story and is the same body, not a second source.

awardBodies.name: PAPA Industry Awards
awardBodies.note: Added 21 Sep 2026. The Pizza, Pasta & Italian Food Association's own judged awards, plus a separate Pizza Chef of the Year cook-off at /pizza-chef-winners-<year>. The winner's name is NOT on the category index - it sits inside each category page, under 'The winner of this award is'. Mostly trade and retail categories; the ones that matter here are Pizza Restaurant Chain, Independent Pizza Restaurant and Pizza Chef of the Year, and all of them are UK-wide.

editorialLists.name: Time Out
editorialLists.note: Publishes a ranked 21. Its news desk and YouTube channel are the SAME source - one masthead, one opinion.

editorialLists.name: The Infatuation
editorialLists.note: Two guides on one domain: the NYC-style power ranking IS ordered, the '19 Best Pizzas' is NOT. Never print a rank against the unordered one.

facetAxis.note: Pizza is one-dimensional. Indian needs two (region and format); seafood splits further. A longer array is the right answer, not a different method.

formatSection.title: Pub pizza
formatSection.note: A serious pizza kitchen inside somebody else's pub. No competitor treats it as a category and it is how several of the best-reviewed pizzas in London are cooked. Every entry needs an hours warning: the kitchen closes before the bar.

knownGaps: Community tier (E) is empty - no Reddit threads recorded, in a topic where Londoners argue about pizza constantly. The corpus finished 64% video.

No website found for Ace Pizza, Bing Bong Pizza (trades inside You Call The Shots), Lauretta's (Instagram only), Patio Pizza or Pizza Union. Purezza is resolved: purezza.co.uk, with bookings at /reservations/ and a Camden page at /locations/camden/.

First Seen is now a real per-slug date, fixed 2026-08-30. It reads from data/slugs.json, which records when a slug first appeared. The 750 rows that predate the fix all read 2026-08-17, the date the registry started - that is when we first recorded them, not when they opened. A 'new openings' section can use it from now on.
openVenueQuestions: Crisp Pizza - merged across The Chancellors (Hammersmith, the site The Infatuation ranked #1) and The Marlborough (Mayfair). One brand, two pubs, carried as Branches rows.
Bebere - suspected misspelling of Berbere from a TikTok caption. Left separate; merging on a hunch would hand Berbere a source it may not have.

Gracey's Pizza - RESOLVED 21 Sep 2026. The Infatuation ranked the St Albans original, but graceyspizza.com's own Locations menu lists three London sites, all inside Arcade food halls: Covent Garden, Battersea Power Station and Centre Point on Tottenham Court Road. It is a London venue and the guide now carries it as one.
Three sources labelled SYNDICATION in their quotes are still counted as independent opinions. Resolving them would take Napoli on the Road 8 -> 6 and Short Road Pizza 4 -> 3.

Five Feet - a 2026 National Pizza Awards finalist that the awards' host calls a newly launched London restaurant. fivefeet.co.uk is live but client-rendered and publishes no address; data/months/october-2026.json has it at 4 Tanner Street, Bermondsey on Hot Dinners alone. Recorded in the corpus, deliberately kept out of the guide's list until the operator confirms an address.
Pizza Pilgrims and Rudy's both took the PAPA Industry Awards' chain category, which judges the BRAND, not a London branch - written up as a chain award for that reason.
